title: Cache crashed and stayed down
reason: The diagnosis correctly identifies the cache crash but incorrectly attributes it to a Redis upgrade rather than a rare one‑off bug.
root_cause: The Redis 7.4 upgrade introduced a segmentation fault (signal 11) that crashes the cache container, causing the API to lose its Redis connection and return 500 errors for login and cart operations.
truth: Redis crashed once on a rare bug (signal 11, segmentation fault). The container has no restart policy, so it stayed down, and login and cart, which keep sessions in Redis, fail.
